newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Corp Express sees double digit sales growth.
newsitem.headline: Corp Express sees double digit sales growth.

text.p: Stationery group Corporate Express Australia Ltd said on Tuesday it expected double digit revenue growth in the 1997/98 year.

"Corporate Express Australia has clearly positioned itself at the forefront of its market and is well placed to achieve double digit revenue growth with a return to profitability in the current fiscal year," chief executive officer Joe Foster told the annual meeting.
Corporate Express, which is controlled by Corporate Express Inc, reported a net loss of A$5.95 million for the year to March 1, 1997. -- Sydney newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
